name: Sampler Adaptive step sizing
plain: Ignores the incoming schedule and picks sigma steps from the agreement of successive x0 velocities, driving any inner sampler one step at a time.
math: σ_t=max(σ−Δ,σ_min). inner(x,[σ,σ_t]). v=x0−x. err=1−|cos(v_prev,v)| or MSE. Δ′=base/(err+bias), Δ=clamp(smooth·Δ+(1−smooth)Δ′,min,max). Defaults base 0.0004, min 0.005 on the node (0.01 in the function), max 0.2, bias 0.002.
label: from code
surprise: Sigma steps are linear additive from sigma_max, so step sizes of 0.01–0.2 assume a flow-like sigma range.

audit.note: Default min differs by layer: function signature min_step_size=0.01 (adaptive_sampler.py:26), but the node widget default is 0.005.
